name: N.M.E. Battle!
summary: N.M.E. Battle! was a web game in the Kirby series that launched on the kirbykirbykirby.com website sometime in November 2002. It was a promotional game alongside Kabu Speaks for Kirby: Right Back at Ya! that tests the player's knowledge of the which Copy Ability Kirby used to defeat a certain monster in the anime. With the shutdown of Flash on December 30, 2020, this game is no longer playable as the site relied on Flash to host the website.
